title: TorusGuardEvidencePackage
description: Structured evidence package schema with raw technical proof, hashes, and provenance for TorusGuard v0.5.1.

type.description: Origin and modality of the technical evidence.

location.description: File path, line number range, configuration key, or route endpoint (e.g. app/views.py:45-52).

raw_snippet.description: Exact, unedited excerpt of the offending source code, configuration, or log.

sha256_checksum.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash of the raw evidence snippet for audit integrity.

collected_at.description: Timestamp when this evidence was extracted.

context.description: Surrounding architectural context (e.g. within unauthenticated route handler).

rationale.description: Technical justification explaining why this code snippet proves the vulnerability.

confidence_level.description: Confidence assessment derived solely from this evidence artifact.

reproduction_notes.description: Specific inputs or conditions required to trigger the issue.

reviewer_notes.description: Human or AI security reviewer annotations.

is_sufficient_for_confirmed.description: True only if direct unmitigated vulnerability is proven without external assumptions.
